paragraphs: We are a commercial-stage company engaged in the discovery and development of medications to treat severe endocrinologic, oncologic, metabolic and neurologic disorders by modulating the effects of the hormone cortisol.

Cortisol plays a significant role in the body's response to stress and is essential for survival. Cortisol influences metabolism and the immune system and contributes to emotional stability. Cortisol levels follow a diurnal rhythm that is essential to health, peaking upon awakening and decreasing during the day. Insufficient cortisol activity may lead to dehydration, hypotension, shock, fatigue and hypoglycemia. Excessive cortisol activity, known as hypercortisolism, may lead to hypertension, diabetes, impaired glucose tolerance, obesity, fatty liver disease, depressed mood, psychosis, wasting of the arms and legs, edema, fatigue, insomnia and other problems.

Cortisol reduces a patient's immune response to oncogenesis, shields certain cancer cells from the apoptotic effects of chemotherapy and facilitates the growth of others. Pre-clinical and clinical data indicate that modulating cortisol activity may improve outcomes in patients with fatty liver disease and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis ("MASH"), which are precursors of liver fibrosis and cirrhosis. Pre-clinical and clinical data also suggest that modulating cortisol activity may lead to treatments for patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis ("ALS").

Since 2012, we have marketed Korlym in the United States for the treatment of patients suffering from hypercortisolism (also known as "Cushing's syndrome"). In June 2024, we made an authorized generic version of Korlym available for the same indication. The challenge in treating a patient with hypercortisolism is modulating cortisol's effects without either inappropriately suppressing them or disrupting cortisol's normal diurnal rhythm. Simply reducing or destroying the ability of the body to make cortisol can cause serious harm. Cortisol activity can be modulated effectively by a drug that competes with cortisol's binding to the glucocorticoid receptor ("GR").

Because Korlym's active ingredient, mifepristone, reduces the binding of excess cortisol to the GR, it can modulate the effects of abnormal levels and release patterns of cortisol without compromising cortisol's healthy functions and rhythms. However, mifepristone also binds to the progesterone receptor ("PR"), thereby terminating pregnancy and causing other adverse effects, including endometrial thickening and vaginal bleeding, a debilitating condition suffered by a significant portion of women who take Korlym.

We have discovered more than 1,000 proprietary cortisol modulators that bind to the GR but have no affinity for the PR and therefore do not cause effects arising from antagonism of progesterone activity, such as termination of pregnancy, endometrial thickening and vaginal bleeding. The composition of these "selective" cortisol modulators and their methods of use in a wide range of indications are covered by U.S. and foreign patents.

Our lead compounds are being evaluated in clinical trials as potential treatments for a variety of serious disorders – hypercortisolism, solid tumors (including ovarian, endometrial, cervical, pancreatic and prostate cancers), ALS and MASH.

Background. Hypercortisolism is the result of a tumor that produces either cortisol or adrenal corticotropic hormone, a hormone that causes the adrenal glands to produce cortisol. Abnormally high levels of cortisol lead to overstimulation of the GR, which gives rise to a wide range of serious adverse effects. Most people with hypercortisolism have one or more of the following symptoms: hypertension, diabetes, impaired glucose tolerance, obesity, fatty liver disease, wasting of the arms and legs, edema, fatigue and insomnia. Irritability, anxiety, cognitive disturbances and depression are also common. Hypercortisolism can affect every organ system in the body and can be lethal if not treated. If the tumor can be found, the preferred treatment is surgery, which, if successful, can cure the disease. In approximately half of patients who receive surgery, the procedure is not successful. Depending on the type of tumor, surgery can also result in a range of complications and recurrence of the disease is common.

Our Products. We sell Korlym and a generic version of Korlym in the United States (our "Products") using sales representatives to call on physicians caring for patients with hypercortisolism. We also have a field-based force of medical science liaisons. From 2017 until 2025, we used an exclusive specialty pharmacy vendor, Optime Care, Inc. ("Optime") and a specialty distributor to distribute our Products and provide logistical support to physicians and patients. In June 2025, we notified Optime that it would cease to be our exclusive specialty pharmacy and in October 2025, we delivered a notice of termination of our agreement with them, effective January 8, 2026. In the fourth quarter of 2025, substantially all of our specialty pharmacy services were transferred from Optime to Curant Health Georgia, LLC ("Curant"). After the first quarter of 2026, Optime will no longer provide specialty pharmacy services related to our Products. Our policy is that no patient with hypercortisolism will be denied access to our Products for financial reasons. To help us achieve that goal, we have patient support programs and donate money to independent charitable foundations that help patients pay for all aspects of their hypercortisolism care, whether or not that care includes taking our Products.

Because most people who suffer from hypercortisolism are undiagnosed or inadequately treated, we have developed and continue to refine and expand programs to educate physicians and patients about screening for hypercortisolism and the role our Products can play in treating patients with the disorder. In 2023 and 2024, we conducted the "CATALYST" study to determine the prevalence of hypercortisolism in patients with difficult-to-control diabetes (defined as HbA1c of 7.5 percent or higher) despite receiving optimum treatment. Of the 1,057 patients enrolled in the first phase of CATALYST, 23.8 percent were found to have hypercortisolism. These patients were offered the chance to enter CATALYST's second phase, in which 136 eligible patients were randomized 2:1 to receive either Korlym or placebo for 24 weeks. The primary endpoint of CATALYST's second phase was a reduction in hemoglobin A1c ("HbA1c") in patients who received Korlym compared to patients who received placebo. CATALYST met this primary endpoint. Patients who received Korlym exhibited a clinically meaningful and statistically significant decrease in HbA1c of 1.47 percent, compared to a decrease of 0.15 percent in patients who received placebo (p-value: < 0.0001). This phase of the trial also met its secondary endpoints. Patients who received Korlym exhibited significantly greater reductions in body weight (5.1 kg; p-value: 0.001) and waist circumference (5.1 cm; p-value: 0.002) than patients who received placebo. The safety profile of Korlym in CATALYST was manageable and consistent with the medication's label: No new side effects or adverse events were identified.

CATALYST's results were published in Diabetes Care (Buse et al., April 2025 (first phase) and DeFronzo et al., June 2025 (second phase)), the peer-reviewed journal of the American Diabetes Association.

To determine the prevalence of hypercortisolism in patients with resistant hypertension, we initiated the MOMENTUM trial in March 2025. Resistant hypertension is defined by the American Heart Association as systolic blood pressure greater than 130mm Hg and diastolic blood pressure greater than 80mm Hg despite the use of three or more antihypertensive medications of different classes, including a diuretic. MOMENTUM completed enrollment of over 1,000 patients in December 2025. Enrollment is closed.
The results of CATALYST and MOMENTUM will help physicians better identify patients with hypercortisolism and determine their optimal treatment.

Relacorilant. We are developing our proprietary, selective cortisol modulator, relacorilant, as a treatment for patients with hypercortisolism. Relacorilant shares Korlym's affinity for the GR but, unlike Korlym, has no affinity for the PR and so is not the "abortion pill" and does not cause other effects associated with PR affinity, including endometrial thickening and vaginal bleeding. Because relacorilant does not meaningfully increase cortisol levels, it does not cause hypokalemia (low potassium), a potentially serious condition that is a leading cause of patients stopping treatment with Korlym. Forty-four percent of patients in Korlym's pivotal trial experienced hypokalemia. Unlike all other medications used to treat hypercortisolism, relacorilant does not prolong the heart's QT interval, a potentially deadly off-target effect.

Risk Factors – Discussion
Failure to generate sufficient revenue from the sale of our Products would harm our financial results and would likely cause our stock price to decline.
The availability of generic versions of Korlym could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial position.
Public perception of mifepristone or legislation limiting or barring its distribution or use for termination of early pregnancy may limit our ability to sell our current Products.
Other companies offer medications that treat patients with hypercortisolism by mechanisms different than Korlym's. The availability of such competing treatments could limit our product revenue.
If we are unable to maintain regulatory approval of our Products or if we fail to comply with other requirements, we will be unable to generate revenue and may be subject to penalties.
We may be subject to civil or criminal penalties if our marketing of our Products violates FDA regulations or health care fraud and abuse laws.
We may be unable to obtain or maintain regulatory approvals for our Products or product candidates, which would prevent us from commercializing our product candidates.

Our Products and product candidates may cause undesirable side effects that halt their clinical development, prevent their regulatory approval, limit their commercial potential or cause us significant liability.

paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves significant risks. Before investing, carefully consider the risks described below and the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes. The risks and uncertainties described below are the ones we believe may materially affect us. There may be others of which we are unaware that could materially harm our business or financial condition and cause the price of our stock to decline, in which case you could lose all or part of your investment.

The following bullet points summarize the principal risks we face, each of which could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results. Below, we have arranged these risks by the part of our business they most directly affect.
•Failure to generate sufficient revenue from the sale of our Products would harm our financial results and would likely cause our stock price to decline.
•The availability of generic versions of Korlym could adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial position.
•Public perception of mifepristone or legislation limiting or barring its distribution or use for termination of early pregnancy may limit our ability to sell our current Products.

•New laws, government regulations, or changes to existing laws and regulations could make it difficult or impossible for us to obtain acceptable prices or adequate insurance coverage and reimbursement for our Products, which would adversely affect our results of operations and financial position.

Relacorilant. We are developing our proprietary, selective cortisol modulator, relacorilant, as a treatment for patients with hypercortisolism. Relacorilant shares Korlym's affinity for the GR but, unlike Korlym, has no affinity for the PR and so is not the "abortion pill" and does not cause other effects associated with PR affinity, including endometrial thickening and vaginal bleeding. Because relacorilant does not meaningfully increase cortisol levels, it does not cause hypokalemia (low potassium), a potentially serious condition that is a leading cause of patients stopping treatment with Korlym. Forty-four percent of patients in Korlym's pivotal trial experienced hypokalemia. Unlike all other medications used to treat hypercortisolism, relacorilant does not prolong the heart's QT interval, a potentially deadly off-target effect.

In December 2024, we submitted a NDA to the FDA seeking approval to market relacorilant as a treatment for patients with endogenous hypercortisolism. The NDA was based on positive results from our pivotal GRACE trial, with confirmatory evidence from our Phase 3 GRADIENT trial, our Phase 3 long-term extension study and our Phase 2 study. Patients in these trials exhibited clinically meaningful improvements in a wide range of hypercortisolism signs and symptoms, including hypertension, glucose control, weight and body composition. Relacorilant has been well-tolerated in all of its clinical trials. Notably, patients did not experience some of the serious adverse events that can arise in patients taking Korlym or other currently approved treatments.

On December 30, 2025, the FDA issued a CRL declining to approve relacorilant. While the letter acknowledged that our GRACE trial had met its primary endpoint and that our GRADIENT trial had provided confirmatory evidence, the FDA stated that additional evidence of efficacy would be required for approval. We are working with the FDA to determine relacorilant's optimal path to approval.

The GRACE trial had two parts. The first, open-label phase enrolled 152 patients with any etiology of hypercortisolism. Each patient received relacorilant for 22 weeks. Patients who exhibited pre-specified improvements in either hypertension, hyperglycemia or both symptoms were eligible to proceed to GRACE's second, double-blind, randomized withdrawal phase, in which half of the patients continued to receive relacorilant and half received placebo for 12 weeks. GRACE's primary endpoint was the number of patients in the relacorilant group who lost blood pressure control compared to the number who lost blood pressure control in the placebo group.

In the open-label phase, patients experienced clinically meaningful and statistically significant improvements in a wide-array of hypercortisolism signs and symptoms, including hypertension, hyperglycemia, weight, waist circumference, fat and lean body mass, cognition and Cushing's Quality of Life score. Rapid and sustained improvements in SBP and DBP were observed in all patients with hypertension, with an improvement in mean SBP of 7.9 mm Hg and mean DBP of 5.4 mm Hg at 22 weeks (p-values: <0.0001). During the open-label phase, 63 percent of patients with hypertension met the study's response criteria. The improvements were even greater in the patients with hypertension who entered the randomized withdrawal phase, with reductions in SBP of 12.6 mm Hg and DBP of 8.3 mm Hg (p-values: <0.0001). To ensure accuracy, hypertension was measured by 24-hour ABPM.

Glucose metabolism was measured by several diagnostic tests, including the oral glucose tolerance test (glucose area under the curve or AUCglucose), HbA1c and fasting glucose. In the open-label phase, clinically meaningful and statistically significant improvements in glucose metabolism were observed in patients with diabetes or impaired glucose tolerance (i.e., pre-diabetes), with reductions in AUCglucose of 3.3 h*mmol/L, HbA1c of 0.3 percent and fasting glucose of 12.4 mg/dL at 22 weeks (p-values: <0.0001, 0.03, 0.03, respectively). During the open-label phase, 50 percent of patients with hyperglycemia met the study's response criteria. Patients with hyperglycemia who entered the randomized withdrawal phase exhibited more pronounced improvements, with reductions in AUCglucose of 6.2 h*mmol/L, HbA1c of 0.7 percent and fasting glucose of 25.2 mg/dL at 22 weeks (p-values: <0.0001, <0.0001, 0.006, respectively).

paragraphs: 本公司為一家商業階段公司，從事發現及開發用以治療嚴重內分泌系統、腫瘤學、代謝及神經系統疾病的藥物，其方式為調節荷爾蒙皮質醇的效應。

皮質醇在身體對壓力的反應中扮演重要角色，並對生存至關重要。皮質醇影響代謝及免疫系統，並有助於情緒穩定。皮質醇水平遵循一種日節律，對健康至關重要，於醒來時達到高峯，並在白天逐漸下降。皮質醇活動不足可能導致脫水、低血壓、休克、疲勞及低血糖。皮質醇活動過度，稱為皮質醇過多症（hypercortisolism），可能導致高血壓、糖尿病、葡萄糖耐受不良、肥胖、脂肪肝、情緒低落、精神病、手臂及腿部肌肉萎縮、水腫、疲勞、失眠及其他問題。
皮質醇會降低患者對腫瘤形成的免疫反應，保護某些癌細胞免受化療的細胞凋亡作用，並促進其他癌細胞的生長。預臨牀及臨牀數據顯示，調節皮質醇活動可能改善患有脂肪肝及代謝功能障礙相關脂肪肝炎（"MASH"）患者的預後，而脂肪肝及MASH是肝纖維化及肝硬化之先驅。預臨牀及臨牀數據也顯示，調節皮質醇活動可能導致治療患有肌萎縮側索硬化症（"ALS"）患者的療法。

自2012年起，本公司已在美國行銷Korlym，用以治療患有皮質醇過多症（亦稱為"庫興氏症候羣"）的患者。2024年6月，本公司已推出Korlym的經授權的仿製藥，用以治療相同症狀。治療皮質醇過多症患者的挑戰在於調節皮質醇的效應，而不適當地抑制其功能或幹擾皮質醇正常的日節律。單純減少或破壞身體製造皮質醇的能力可能導致嚴重傷害。皮質醇活動可透過一種與皮質醇競爭結合至糖皮質激素受體（"GR"）的藥物有效調節。
由於Korlym的活性成分米非司酮（mifepristone）會減少過多皮質醇與GR的結合，因此可調節異常皮質醇水平及釋放模式的效應，而不影響皮質醇的健康功能及節律。然而，米非司酮也會與黃體素受體（"PR"）結合，因此會終止懷孕並導致其他不良影響，包括子宮內膜增厚及陰道出血，這是一種影響大量服用Korlym女性的嚴重症狀。
本公司已發現超過1,000項專利的皮質醇調節物，這些物質會結合至GR，但對PR無親和力，因此不會導致因拮抗黃體素活動而產生的影響，例如終止懷孕、子宮內膜增厚及陰道出血。這些"選擇性"皮質醇調節物的組成及其在廣泛適應症中的使用方法，已受到美國及外國專利的保護。
本公司主要化合物正在臨牀試驗中評估，作為治療多種嚴重疾病的潛在療法，包括皮質醇過多症、實體腫瘤（包括卵巢、子宮內膜、陰道、胰臟及前列腺癌）、ALS及MASH。

背景。皮質醇過多症是因腫瘤產生皮質醇或促腎上腺皮質激素（一種導致腎上腺產生皮質醇的荷爾蒙）所致。皮質醇異常高水準會導致GR過度刺激，進而引發一系列嚴重的不良影響。大多數皮質醇過多症患者會出現以下一種或多種症狀：高血壓、糖尿病、葡萄糖耐受不良、肥胖、脂肪肝、手臂及腿部肌肉萎縮、水腫、疲勞及失眠。易怒、焦慮、認知障礙及抑鬱也是常見症狀。皮質醇過多症可能影響身體每一個器官系統，若未治療可能致命。若能發現腫瘤，則手術是首選治療方式，若手術成功，可根治此病。約有半數接受手術的患者手術未成功。根據腫瘤類型，手術也可能導致一系列併發症，且疾病復發率相當高。

我們的產品。我們在美國銷售 Korlym 以及 Korlym 的通用版本（我們的「產品」），透過銷售代表拜訪照顧患有高皮質醇症患者的醫師。我們也擁有基於現場的醫療科學聯絡人團隊。從 2017 年至 2025 年，我們使用專屬的特種藥房供應商 Optime Care, Inc.（「Optime」）以及特種藥品經銷商來分銷我們的產品並提供物流支援給醫師與患者。2025 年 6 月，我們通知 Optime 他們將不再成為我們的專屬特種藥房供應商，2025 年 10 月，我們發出終止與 Optime 約定的通知，生效日期為 2026 年 1 月 8 日。2025 年第四季，我們將幾乎所有特種藥房服務從 Optime 轉移至 Curant Health Georgia, LLC（「Curant」）。2026 年第一季之後，Optime 將不再提供與我們產品相關的特種藥房服務。我們的政策是，不會因財務原因拒絕患有高皮質醇症的患者使用我們的產品。為協助我們達成此目標，我們有患者支持計畫，並捐錢給獨立的慈善基金會，協助患者支付所有高皮質醇症照護的費用，不管該照護是否包含使用我們的產品。

因為大多數患有高皮質醇症的人未被診斷或治療不當，我們已開發並持續改善與擴展計畫，以教育醫師與患者關於高皮質醇症篩檢以及我們的產品在治療此症狀患者所扮演的角色。2023 年與 2024 年，我們進行了「CATALYST」研究，以確定在難以控制的糖尿病患者（定義為 HbA1c 7.5％或更高）中高皮質醇症的盛行率，即使接受最佳治療。在 CATALYST 第一階段 enrol 的 1,057 名患者中，23.8％被發現患有高皮質醇症。這些患者被提供機會進入 CATALYST 的第二階段，其中 136 名合格患者被隨機 2:1 分配至接受 Korlym 或安慰劑 24 週。CATALYST 第二階段的主要終點是比較接受 Korlym 的患者與接受安慰劑的患者，其 HbA1c 的減少情況。CATALYST 達成此主要終點。接受 Korlym 的患者顯示 HbA1c 有臨牀意義且統計上顯著的減少 1.47％，與接受安慰劑的患者減少 0.15％相比（p 值：< 0.0001）。此階段的試驗也達成其次要終點。接受 Korlym 的患者顯示體重顯著減少（5.1 公斤；p 值：0.001）與腰圍顯著減少（5.1 公分；p 值：0.002）多於接受安慰劑的患者。Korlym 在 CATALYST 中的安全性可管理，且與藥物標籤一致：未發現新的副作用或不良事件。
CATALYST 的結果已發表於 Diabetes Care（Buse 等人，2025 年 4 月（第一階段）與 DeFronzo 等人，2025 年 6 月（第二階段）），為美國糖尿病協會的同儕審查期刊。
為確定在難治性高血壓患者中高皮質醇症的盛行率，我們於 2025 年 3 月啟動 MOMENTUM 試驗。難治性高血壓被美國心臟協會定義為，即使使用三種或更多不同類別的降血壓藥物（包括利尿劑），收縮壓仍高於 130mm Hg 且舒張壓高於 80mm Hg。MOMENTUM 於 2025 年 12 月完成 enrol 超過 1,000 名患者， enrol 已關閉。
CATALYST 與 MOMENTUM 的結果將協助醫師更準確辨識高皮質醇症患者並決定其最佳治療方案。

Relacorilant。我們正在開發我們的專利、選擇性皮質醇調節劑 Relacorilant，作為高皮質醇症患者的治療方案。Relacorilant 具有與 Korlym 相同的 GR 親和力，但與 Korlym 不同的是，它對 PR 沒有親和力，因此不是「終止藥」，也不會造成與 PR 親和力相關的其他效果，包括子宮增厚與陰道出血。因為 Relacorilant 不會顯著提高皮質醇水平，因此不會導致低血鉀（低鉀），這是一種可能嚴重的狀況，是導致患者停止使用 Korlym 的主要原因。在 Korlym 的關鍵試驗中，44％的患者經歷低血鉀。與所有其他用於治療高皮質醇症的藥物不同，Relacorilant 不會延長心臟的 QT 項間期，這是一種可能致命的脫標效果。

paragraphs: 以下為管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之分析（"MD&A"），旨在協助讀者瞭解本公司營運成果與財務狀況，並作為補充本公司經審計之合併財務報表及相關財務報表附註、風險因素及其他揭露資訊之參考。本公司的合併財務報表係依照美國通用會計準則（"U.S. GAAP"）編製。

本節所載之陳述為「向前看」（"forward-looking"）之陳述，係依照美國聯邦證券法之定義。有關此類陳述之完整討論及可能影響其準確性之潛在風險與不確定性，請參閱本表10-K之「風險因素」、「概觀」及「流動性與資本運用」等節。有關2023年度項目及2024年度與2023年度之年對年比較資訊，未於本節載明，可於本公司2024年度財務年度（截至2024年12月31日）之表10-K「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之分析」（Part II, Item 7）中查閱。
本公司為一家商業階段公司，專注於發現及開發用以治療嚴重內分泌、腫瘤、代謝及神經系統疾病之藥物，其方式為調節賀爾蒙皮質醇之作用。自2012年起，本公司已在美國行銷Korlym，用以治療患有高皮質醇症（亦稱為「庫興氏症候羣」）之患者。2024年6月，本公司推出Korlym之經核准之通用藥品。本公司專利之選擇性皮質醇調節劑組合包含四種結構上不同之系列，總計超過1,000種化合物。

本公司產品。本公司透過銷售代表拜訪照顧高皮質醇症患者之醫師來銷售產品。本公司亦設有現場醫療科學聯絡人團隊。自2017年至2025年，本公司使用專屬之專科藥房供應商Optime及專科分銷商來分銷產品並提供給醫師及患者之物流支援。2025年6月，本公司通知Optime將不再為本公司專屬之專科藥房供應商，並於2025年10月遞交終止與Optime之協議通知，生效日期為2026年1月8日。2025年第四季，本公司將幾乎所有之專科藥房服務從Optime轉移至Curant。2026年第一季後，Optime將不再提供與本公司產品相關之專科藥房服務。本公司政策為不因財務因素而拒絕任何高皮質醇症患者使用本公司產品。為協助達成此目標，本公司設有患者支援計畫，並捐贈資金給獨立之慈善基金會，協助患者支付所有高皮質醇症照護之費用，無論該照護是否包含使用本公司產品。

由於大多數高皮質醇症患者未被診斷或治療不充分，本公司已開發並持續改善與擴展計畫，用以教育醫師及患者進行高皮質醇症篩檢，並說明本公司產品在治療此疾病患者之角色。2023年及2024年，本公司進行CATALYST研究，以確定在難以控制之糖尿病患者（定義為HbA1c為7.5%或更高，即使接受最佳治療）中高皮質醇症之盛行率。在CATALYST第一階段納入之1,057名患者中，有23.8%被發現患有高皮質醇症。這些患者被提供機會參與CATALYST第二階段，其中136名合格患者被隨機以2:1比例分為接受Korlym或安慰劑組，進行24週治療。CATALYST第二階段之主要評估指標為接受Korlym治療之患者與接受安慰劑治療之患者之HbA1c降低情形。CATALYST達成此主要評估指標。接受Korlym治療之患者顯示出臨牀意義且統計上顯著的HbA1c降低1.47%，與接受安慰劑治療之患者降低0.15%相比（p值：< 0.0001）。此階段之試驗亦達成其次要評估指標。接受Korlym治療之患者顯示出顯著較大的體重減少（5.1公斤；p值：0.001）及腰圍減少（5.1公分；p值：0.002）情形，與接受安慰劑治療之患者相比。Korlym在CATALYST中之安全性表現可管理，且與藥物標籤一致：未發現任何新之副作用或不良事件。
CATALYST之結果已發表於Diabetes Care（Buse等人，2025年4月（第一階段）及DeFronzo等人，2025年6月（第二階段）），為美國糖尿病協會之同儕評審期刊。
為確定在難以控制之高血壓患者中高皮質醇症之盛行率，本公司於2025年3月啟動MOMENTUM試驗。難以控制之高血壓被美國心臟協會定義為：即使使用三種或以上不同類別之降血壓藥物（包括利尿劑），收縮壓仍高於130mm Hg，舒張壓高於80mm Hg。MOMENTUM於2025年12月完成納入超過1,000名患者，納入已截止。
CATALYST及MOMENTUM之結果將協助醫師更準確識別高皮質醇症患者，並決定其最佳治療方案。

Relacorilant. 我們正在開發我們的專利、選擇性皮質醇調節劑 Relacorilant，作為治療皮質醇過高的患者。Relacorilant 具有 Korlym 對 GR 的親和力，但與 Korlym 不同的是，它對 PR 沒有親和力，因此不是所謂的「墮胎藥」，也不會造成與 PR 親和力相關的其他效果，包括子宮內膜增厚和陰道出血。因為 Relacorilant 不會顯著提高皮質醇水平，因此不會導致低血鉀（低鉀），這是一種可能嚴重的狀況，是導致患者停止使用 Korlym 治療的主要原因之一。在 Korlym 的關鍵性試驗中，44% 的患者經歷了低血鉀。與所有用來治療皮質醇過高的其他藥物不同，Relacorilant 不會延長心臟的 QT 項間期，這是一種可能致命的離標效應。

2024 年 12 月，我們向美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）提交了新藥申請（NDA），尋求批准 Relacorilant 作為治療皮質醇過高患者的藥物。NDA 是基於我們關鍵性 GRACE 試驗的正面結果，並有我們第三期 GRADIENT 試驗、第三期長期延長研究以及第二期試驗的確認性證據。這些試驗中的患者在廣泛的皮質醇過高症狀和症狀上表現出臨牀意義重大的改善，包括高血壓、血糖控制、體重和體成分。Relacorilant 在所有臨牀試驗中都具有良好耐受性。值得注意的是，患者未經歷一些在使用 Korlym 或其他目前批准的治療藥物時可能出現的嚴重不良事件。
2025 年 12 月 30 日，FDA 發出一封 CRL，拒絕批准 Relacorilant。雖然該信件承認我們的 GRACE 試驗已達成其主要終點，且 GRADIENT 試驗提供了確認性證據，但 FDA 表示需要更多的有效性證據才能批准。我們正在與 FDA 合作，以確定 Relacorilant 最佳的批准途徑。

GRACE 試驗分為兩個階段。第一階段為開放標籤階段，納入 152 名任何病因的皮質醇過高患者。每位患者接受 Relacorilant 22 週。那些在預設改善標準中表現出高血壓、高血糖或兩者症狀改善的患者，有資格進入 GRACE 的第二階段，即雙盲隨機撤藥階段，其中一半患者繼續接受 Relacorilant，另一半接受安慰劑 12 週。GRACE 的主要終點是 Relacorilant 羣組中失去血壓控制的患者數目，與安慰劑羣組中失去血壓控制的患者數目相比。

在開放標籤階段，患者在廣泛的皮質醇過高症狀和症狀上表現出臨牀意義重大且統計學上顯著的改善，包括高血壓、高血糖、體重、腰圍、脂肪和瘦體質量、認知功能以及庫欣症候羣生活品質評分。所有高血壓患者均觀察到 SBP 和 DBP 的快速且持續改善，22 週時 SBP 平均改善 7.9 mm Hg，DBP 平均改善 5.4 mm Hg（p 值：<0.0001）。在開放標籤階段，63% 的高血壓患者符合研究的反應標準。在進入隨機撤藥階段的高血壓患者中，改善更為顯著，SBP 減少 12.6 mm Hg，DBP 減少 8.3 mm Hg（p 值：<0.0001）。為確保準確性，高血壓是透過 24 小時動態血壓監測（ABPM）測量的。

葡萄糖代謝是透過多種診斷測試來測量的，包括口服葡萄糖耐受試驗（葡萄糖曲線下面積或 AUCglucose）、HbA1c 和空腹血糖。在開放標籤階段，患有糖尿病或葡萄糖耐受不良（即前糖尿病）的患者在葡萄糖代謝上觀察到臨牀意義重大且統計學上顯著的改善，22 週時 AUCglucose 減少 3.3 h*mmol/L，HbA1c 減少 0.3%，空腹血糖減少 12.4 mg/dL（p 值：<0.0001、0.03、0.03，分別）。在開放標籤階段，50% 的高血糖患者符合研究的反應標準。進入隨機撤藥階段的高血糖患者表現出更顯著的改善，22 週時 AUCglucose 減少 6.2 h*mmol/L，HbA1c 減少 0.7%，空腹血糖減少 25.2 mg/dL（p 值：<0.0001、<0.0001、0.006，分別）。

一般風險因素
風險因素 – 討論
若無法從我們產品的銷售產生足夠的營業收入，將會損害我們的財務表現，並可能導致我們股票價格下跌。
Korlym 之一般版本之可取得性可能對本公司之業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
有關米非司酮之公共觀感或限制其分銷或用於早期懷孕終止之立法，可能限制本公司銷售現有產品之能力。
其他公司提供用以治療具有高皮質醇症候羣之患者之藥物，其作用機制與 Korlym 不同。上述競爭性治療之可取得性可能限制本公司產品之營收。
若本公司無法維持對產品之監管核准，或未能遵守其他要求，將無法產生營收，並可能面臨處罰。
若本公司產品之行銷違反 FDA 規範或醫療詐欺與濫用法規，本公司可能面臨民事或刑事處罰。
本公司可能無法取得或維持對產品或產品候選藥物之監管核准，此將阻礙本公司商業化產品候選藥物。
本公司產品及產品候選藥物可能導致不希望之副作用，此可能中止其臨牀開發、阻礙其監管核准、限制其商業潛力或使本公司面臨重大賠償責任。
與本公司資金需求相關之風險
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及重大風險。在投資前，請仔細考慮下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報告表 10-K 中的其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及相關附註。下列所描述的風險與不確定性，是我們認為可能重大影響我們的風險。尚有其他我們未察覺的風險，可能對我們的業務或財務狀況造成重大損害，並導致本公司股票價格下跌，屆時您可能損失全部或部分投資。
下列項目重點說明我們所面臨的主要風險，每一項都可能對我們的業務、營運及財務結果造成不利影響。以下，我們依照這些風險最直接影響的業務部分進行分類。
